WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT e.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
  WHERE e.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
    AND e.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.orderflow
)
SELECT AVG(avg_filled_quantity) AS result
FROM group_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Expiry values are compared lexically as text, as requested; this assumes their stored text format is consistent with the supplied timestamp strings.
